request: In the side panel that shows the selected card, clicking the owner's name should show only that person's cards on the board.
pointRequest: Clicking this name should show only this person's cards on the board.

reference.message: Clicking the owner shows their cards

set./program/drawer.lisp/detail-owner:
(defview detail-owner "The card's owner, in the drawer." []
  `(node#detailOwner :style caption
     :icon user
     :text ~(or-else (:name (find (fn [it] (= it.who computed.card.who)) state.members)) computed.card.who)
     :anchors {:left 12}
     :onClick {:set state.owner :to ~computed.card.who}
     :height 18))
